import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[] lsc = new long[62], rsc = new long[62], rsc2 = new long[62];
    static char[] s;
    static Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> nm = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> mm = new HashMap<>();

    static class Pair<K, V> {
        K first;
        V second;

        Pair(K first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair<?, ?> pair = (Pair<?, ?>) o;
            return Objects.equals(first, pair.first) && Objects.equals(second, pair.second);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            res = res * (n - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int n = 2 * (r + c);
        s = br.readLine().toCharArray();

        lsc[2 * r - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * r; i < n; i++) {
            lsc[i] = lsc[i - 1] * i / (i - 2 * r + 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            rsc[i] = comb(i, r);
            rsc2[i] = comb(i, r - 1);
        }

        long halfSum = rsc[n / 2] * rsc[n / 2];
        long totalSum = 0;
        int cntA = 0, cntB = 0;
        int ok, aSt, bSt;

        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (totalSum > 0) ok = 1; else ok = 0;
            if (cntB == n / 2) ok = 1;
            if (cntA == n / 2) ok = 0;
            if (ok != 0) {
                cntA++;
                totalSum -= rsc2[n / 2 - cntA] * rsc[n / 2 - cntB];
            } else {
                cntB++;
                totalSum += rsc2[n / 2 - cntB] * rsc[n / 2 - cntA];
            }
        }
        totalSum = Math.max(totalSum, -totalSum);

        mm.clear();
        mm.put(new Pair<>(0L, 0), 1L);

        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 2 * r - 1; i--) {
            nm.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
                long count = entry.getValue();

                aSt = n / 2 - cnt;
                bSt = i + 1 - aSt;
                long aSum = sum + rsc2[aSt - 1] * rsc[bSt];
                long bSumVal = sum - rsc2[bSt - 1] * rsc[aSt];

                if (s[i] == 'A') {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyA = new Pair<>(aSum, cnt + 1);
                    nm.put(keyA, nm.getOrDefault(keyA, 0L) + count);
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyB = new Pair<>(bSumVal, cnt);
                    nm.put(keyB, nm.getOrDefault(keyB, 0L));
                } else if (s[i] == 'B') {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyA = new Pair<>(aSum, cnt + 1);
                    nm.put(keyA, nm.getOrDefault(keyA, 0L));
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyB = new Pair<>(bSumVal, cnt);
                    nm.put(keyB, nm.getOrDefault(keyB, 0L) + count);
                } else {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyA = new Pair<>(aSum, cnt + 1);
                    nm.put(keyA, nm.getOrDefault(keyA, 0L) + count);
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyB = new Pair<>(bSumVal, cnt);
                    nm.put(keyB, nm.getOrDefault(keyB, 0L) + count);
                }
            }
            totalSum -= lsc[i];
            mm.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : nm.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
                long ncnt = entry.getValue();

                aSt = n / 2 - cnt;
                bSt = i - aSt;

                if (cnt > n / 2 || n - i - cnt > n / 2) continue;
                long minSum = -halfSum - rsc[aSt] * rsc[bSt];
                long maxSum = halfSum + rsc[aSt] * rsc[bSt];
                if (sum < minSum || sum > maxSum) continue;

                Pair<Long, Integer> key = new Pair<>(sum, cnt);
                mm.put(key, mm.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + ncnt);
            }
        }

        long bSum = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            bSum = Math.min(bSum, Math.max(sum, -sum));
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            long ncnt = entry.getValue();
            int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
            if (sum == bSum || sum == -bSum) {
                int sem = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 2 * r - 1; i++) {
                    if (s[i] == '?') sem++;
                    else if (s[i] == 'A') cnt++;
                }
                long ways = comb(sem, n / 2 - cnt);
                ncnt *= ways;
                result += ncnt;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
